summary: Italy (IT) localization of Business Central 29 covering Italian VAT (non-deductible VAT, VAT settlement, VAT transactions reports), withholding tax and contributions, customer and vendor bills with SEPA, FatturaPA e-invoicing, Intrastat, fiscal inventory valuation, Italian fixed asset depreciation and subcontracting. It answers what Italy adds to W1 and where.
overview:
The Italian layer is large: 551 objects, 829 fields added to W1 tables, 92 events and 337 procedures. Most of the change is on posting and document tables. Sales, purchase, journal and VAT entry tables gain fields such as Operation Type, Operation Occurred Date, Activity Code, Service Tariff No., Deductible % and Fiscal Code. Codeunits Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Sales-Post and Purch.-Post carry most of the new events and procedures.

Own objects cover the local features. These are bills and bill posting groups, withholding tax and INPS contributions, periodic VAT settlement, the annual VAT communication, G/L book and VAT register printing, Spesometro and Datifattura exports, the FatturaPA export and Fattura setup, payment lines for installment terms, LIFO and fiscal inventory valuation, compressed depreciation, and the Intrastat IT extensions. Learn documents these in the Italy local functionality pages. Subcontracting is documented as deprecated and replaced by a separate Subcontracting app, with a migration for sandboxes.

Developers can hook the new events in posting, bill handling, VAT report validation, fixed asset batch posting and the cash flow worksheet. Setup is concentrated on General Ledger Setup, Company Information, VAT Posting Setup, Payment Terms and the Fattura Setup page.
key_points: VAT: non-deductible VAT, Deductible % on lines and VAT entries, VAT posting setup fields, Calc. and Post VAT Settlement with rounding and minimum payable, and Italian VAT statements.
VAT transactions reports: suggest lines by threshold, validate, export as .ccf files, correct or cancel reports and record tax authority receipt numbers.
Withholding tax and INPS contribution codes, brackets and payment lists, driven by fields on Vendor and calculated at payment.
Customer and vendor bills with bill codes, bill posting groups, SEPA credit transfer and direct debit export, and CBI payment request file support.
FatturaPA electronic invoicing with Fattura Setup, document types, codes, project info and self-billing export.
Fiscal reporting: G/L book and VAT register printing with page numbering, Intrastat IT with corrective entries, fiscal denial list, Italian payment terms with installments.
Fiscal inventory valuation (average, FIFO, LIFO, discrete LIFO) and fixed asset anticipated, accelerated, reduced and compressed depreciation.
Legacy subcontracting with WIP items, subcontractor prices and transfer orders, deprecated in favor of the Subcontracting app.

areas.what: Core Italian VAT and ledger logic. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gets bill handling, unrealized VAT and non-deductible VAT procedures with many events. VAT Entry, VAT Posting Setup, General Ledger Setup and journal lines gain local fields. VAT report objects get suggest, validate and export logic, and own codeunits export Spesometro, withholding tax and VAT payment communication.
areas.why: Learn describes Italian VAT with non-deductible VAT, service tariffs and reverse charge, and VAT transactions reports for amounts above a threshold, plus VAT settlement and statement submission.

areas.what: Adds customer and vendor bills with issuing, posting, recall and status change, bill posting groups and ABI/CAB lists. Bank account tables gain ABI, CAB and BBAN with IBAN checks. SEPA credit transfer and direct debit codeunits are extended, and INPS contribution pages sit here.
areas.why: Learn documents automatic payments and bills, SEPA Credit Transfer and Direct Debit and the Italian bill formats.

areas.what: Italian counterparts for service documents: edit codeunits for posted service documents, page extensions for service orders, invoices and contracts, FatturaPA validation hooks, and service declaration (service Intrastat) objects with periodicity and report type enums.

Transfer orders gain transport document fields (reason code, weight, loader, goods appearance) and WIP subcontracting fields. Intrastat tables and Intrastat Report IT objects handle the Italian format. Own LIFO, item cost history and fiscal inventory valuation reports and pages live here.
areas.why: Learn describes Intrastat for Italy with periodicity, corrective entries and file disk numbers, and fiscal inventory valuation by several cost methods.

areas.what: Sales documents, archives and posted documents gain operation type, operation occurred date, activity code, fiscal code and individual person data. Customer gets fiscal code, PA code, PEC e-mail and bill fields. Sales-Post and prepayment posting get payment line and VAT report logic, and split VAT line procedures are added.
areas.why: Learn covers VAT transactions report preparation (individual person, resident, tax representative) and FatturaPA invoicing to public administration.

areas.what: Purchase documents gain operation type, check total, reverse sales VAT, activity code and tax representative fields. Vendor carries withholding tax, social security and birth and residence data. Purch.-Post adds withholding and social security posting, fixed asset splitting and payment line events.
areas.why: Learn documents withholding tax set up per vendor and calculated at payment, and the fixed asset card creation from invoices.

areas.what: Legacy Italian subcontracting: subcontracting orders, transfer orders, prices, WIP item fields on routing and production order routing lines, dispatching and transfer shipment reports, plus migration and upgrade codeunits.
areas.why: Learn states the feature is deprecated and replaced by the Subcontracting app, with a migration for sandbox environments.

areas.what: Company Information gets Italian registration, REA and tax representative fields. Payment Terms get installment payment lines (Payment Lines and Posted Payment Lines tables), No. Series gets VAT register types, and Country/Region gets deny list fields. Company officials and company types are new.
areas.why: Learn covers payment terms with installments and discount dates, company information setup and the fiscal denial list.

areas.what: FatturaPA electronic invoicing: export codeunit, sales and service validation, Fattura header and line tables, setup, document types, codes, project info and self-billing export.
areas.why: Learn describes FatturaPA invoicing to public administration through the SDI platform, with setup for invoices, credit memos, self-billing and prepayments.

areas.what: Adds anticipated, accelerated and reduced depreciation through depreciation table fields, compressed depreciation posting in FA Jnl.-Post Batch, new Depreciation Book report, and extra procedures in depreciation calculation.
areas.why: Learn documents alternate depreciation methods, compressed depreciation to reduce ledger entries, and the Depreciation Book report.

areas.what: Italy extensions to No. Series and No. Series Line, an IT no. series codeunit, the CBI payment request XMLport and upgrade codeunits for detailed ledger entries and periodic VAT settlement entries.
Local helper objects: activity codes, appointment codes, Spesometro appointments, the fiscal code check setup and report management and application management codeunits.
Flat file management codeunit, a blacklist communication amount table and a document relation table.
The LOCAL, LOCAL READ and VAT Report - Edit permission sets are changed to cover the Italian objects.
A feature management codeunit for Italy and application area additions, including the legacy subcontracting application area.
Employee gets birth place fields, and employee entry application gets VAT settlement and unrealized VAT checks.
Cash Flow Worksheet Line gets new events and procedures for posted and unposted document calculation, credit memos and payment tolerance.
Contact gets a Fiscal Code field and a transport document address procedure.
Job Transfer Line gets a reverse charge VAT amount procedure and an event after validating job journal quantity.
